story.body: You dated the lovers at ten days short of a month and left the prologue unhelped. You took Burbage's promise not to look away, and Phillips's order that gladness does not buy the note. You did not open a sum.

story.body: You let the search stand at half an hour and at nothing. You did not pick the button up, because it was not there. You let Heminges park Kemp's aside until the inn down the river, and you did not start the walk to bed.
